'''K-3RNL''' was a [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was considered to be corny, yet sweet.

==Behind the scenes==
K-3RNL was a droid purchasable in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]]. It was able to be purchased exclusively during the Halloween season.

K-3RNL's name resembles the word "kernel," as in a kernel of corn. This is likely a pun referencing the droid's color scheme which, along with the R4-series' distinctive head shape, gives K-3RNL a resemblance to the common Halloween sweet candy corn.
